'''Andreo Tagge''' was an individual who served as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], and brought vast expertise regarding the management of [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]]. Under Tagge, much of Cerea's land was annexed and industrialized against Cerea's terms of surrender to the Empire, and the planet's [[Cerean/Legends|inhabitants]] had much discontent with Tagge and the Empire's rule.<ref name="FaDCR" />
